nodes.description: Private owner address; being owner bypasses the ensure() whitelist and is the required caller for init, delegate, _mints, batchSend and setTradeAddress.
Public mapping of user token balances, mutated with raw arithmetic in transferFrom, batchSend and _mints.
Public nested mapping of spending allowances, read and decremented with raw arithmetic in transferFrom and written unchecked in approve.
Private mapping granting an unconditional transfer whitelist in ensure(); set to true by _mints.
Address whitelisted inside ensure() so transfers to/from it always succeed; attacker-settable by owner via setTradeAddress.
Minimum sale amount consulted by condition(); written unchecked by init.
Maximum sale amount consulted by condition(); written unchecked by init.
Number of allowed sales per account; when zero, selling is disabled in condition().
Per-account sale counter incremented by transferFrom and compared against _saleNum in condition().
Constant 18 used as a scaling exponent in init and _mints, allowing extreme values.
Total supply, minted entirely to the deployer in the constructor.
Hardcoded Uniswap router address that is always whitelisted by ensure().
Deployer constructor: sets name/symbol, mints totalSupply to msg.sender, sets owner and an infinite allowance to the Uniswap router.
Public payable transfer that forwards the call to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Whitelist gate used by transferFrom: returns true for owner, UNI, the pair address, tradeAddress or canSale accounts, otherwise defers to condition().
Core transfer logic: checks allowance, calls ensure(), then mutates balanceOf and allowance with raw unchecked arithmetic.
Public payable approve that blindly writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value.
View helper enforcing _saleNum, _onSaleNum, _minSale and _maxSale limits for non-whitelisted accounts.
Owner-only function performing a.delegatecall(b) on an arbitrary attacker-supplied address.
Privileged mint that overwrites balanceOf[spender] with addedValue*(10**decimals) and sets canSale[spender]=true.
Owner-only initializer that writes _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum using raw multiplication.
Owner-only batch distributor that computes total = _value*_tos.length and loops balance updates with raw arithmetic.
Owner-only setter for tradeAddress, the address whitelisted by ensure().
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, transferFrom source, approve owner and mint/init/batch authorization.
delegatecall executed in delegate() against an arbitrary address, running foreign code with this contract's storage.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value in transferFrom performed without SafeMath.
balanceOf[_to] += _value in transferFrom performed without SafeMath.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value in transferFrom performed without SafeMath.
total = _value * _tos.length plus balanceOf additions in batchSend, all without overflow protection.
Unchecked balanceOf[spender] = addedValue*(10**decimals) overwrite in _mints, reachable only through a weak owner/backdoor address check.
token*(10**decimals) and maxToken*(10**decimals) computations in init with no overflow guard.
Source address parameter of transferFrom/ensure, also used as the ensure() whitelist key.
Destination address parameter of transferFrom.
Amount parameter of transferFrom/transfer, driving all unchecked balance and allowance arithmetic.
Target contract address parameter of delegate, used directly as the delegatecall destination.
Arbitrary calldata parameter of delegate, forwarded to delegatecall.
Account parameter of _mints whose balance is overwritten.
Amount parameter of _mints multiplied by 10**decimals without overflow checks.
Array of recipient addresses in batchSend whose length scales the unchecked total.
Local product _value*_tos.length in batchSend, computed without SafeMath.
Loop index of batchSend used for the unchecked balance distribution.
Per-iteration recipient of batchSend whose balance is incremented with raw arithmetic.
Address parameter of setTradeAddress that becomes the ensure() whitelisted tradeAddress.

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as _from into transferFrom, allowing the caller to move tokens out of any account it controls without a signature.
transferFrom subtracts _value from balanceOf[_from] with raw arithmetic.
transferFrom adds _value to balanceOf[_to] with raw arithmetic.
transferFrom decrements the spender allowance with raw arithmetic.
_from selects which balance slot is decremented in the unchecked subtraction.
_to selects which balance slot is incremented in the unchecked addition.
_value is subtracted from balanceOf without SafeMath.
_value is added to balanceOf without SafeMath.
_value is subtracted from the allowance without SafeMath.
transfer simply forwards its arguments to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
transferFrom is gated by require(ensure(...)), so the whitelist decides whether a transfer is allowed.
condition() decides whether the sale restrictions pass and therefore whether ensure() returns.
canSale[_from] grants an unconditional whitelist bypass in ensure().
tradeAddress is unconditionally whitelisted inside ensure().
The owner address always bypasses ensure().
_onSaleNum[_from] is compared with _saleNum in condition() to cap sales.
_minSale lower-bounds the amount accepted by condition().
_maxSale upper-bounds the amount accepted by condition().
_saleNum being zero disables all non-whitelisted sells.
balanceOf is read and written by transferFrom using unchecked math.
allowance is read and decremented by transferFrom using unchecked math.
delegate() performs delegatecall on the user-supplied address a.
msg.sender must equal owner to reach the delegatecall, but arbitrary delegatecall is still exposed.
Parameter a is used directly as the delegatecall target contract.
Parameter b is forwarded as raw calldata to delegatecall.
The delegatecall executes foreign code in this storage context, so the callee can overwrite owner and seize control.
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length without SafeMath.
_tos.length scales the unchecked total and the loop count.
Local total carries the unchecked product into the balance update.
Loop index i drives unbounded unchecked balance additions.
Each _to receives balanceOf[_to] += _value with raw arithmetic.
batchSend is restricted by require(msg.sender == owner).
_mints overwrites balanceOf[spender] with an arbitrary amount instead of adding to it.
spender chooses which account balance is overwritten by the mint.
addedValue*(10**decimals) is computed with no overflow protection.
The minted value is written directly into balanceOf[spender].
_mints relies on msg.sender for its privileged owner/backdoor-address check.
The owner address satisfies the _mints guard and can mint to any account.
_mints sets canSale[spender] = true, granting a permanent whitelist bypass.
init multiplies the sale-limit arguments by 10**decimals with raw arithmetic.
_minSale is set from the unchecked init argument.
_maxSale is set from the unchecked init argument.
_saleNum is set by the owner and controls whether selling works at all.
init is restricted by require(msg.sender == owner).
owner is the caller required to run init.
setTradeAddress writes the address that ensure() unconditionally whitelists.
Parameter addr becomes the new tradeAddress, giving the owner a full ensure() bypass for that address.
setTradeAddress is gated by require(msg.sender == owner).
owner is the only account able to change the whitelisted tradeAddress.
The constructor sets owner = msg.sender, the deployer.
The constructor trusts msg.sender as the privileged deployer.
The constructor mints the entire totalSupply to the deployer.
totalSupply is reflected in balanceOf[msg.sender] at deployment.
The hardcoded UNI router address is unconditionally whitelisted in ensure().
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] to enforce the sale counter.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] with no checks, enabling arbitrary approval overwrites.
approve uses msg.sender as the owner of the allowance slot.

normalization_plan.reason: _from is only meaningful as the source key for transferFrom's unchecked balance/allowance updates and should be folded into that function node.
_to is a transient destination key for transferFrom's unchecked balance addition; it carries no standalone state.
_value is the transient amount consumed by transferFrom's raw balance and allowance math.
Parameter a is only the delegatecall target inside delegate and should be merged into that function node.
Parameter b is only raw calldata forwarded by delegate and has no independent semantics.
spender only selects the balance slot overwritten by _mints and belongs to that function node.
addedValue is the transient amount scaled by _mints before the unchecked balance overwrite.
_tos is the recipient list whose length drives batchSend's unchecked total; it should be folded into batchSend.
Local total is the unchecked product inside batchSend and merges into batchSend's arithmetic operation.
Loop index i exists only to iterate batchSend's unchecked balance distribution.
The per-iteration recipient exists only within batchSend's transfer loop.
addr is only the new whitelisted tradeAddress written by setTradeAddress and merges into that function node.
